title: Leave the canvas (move out of content)
when_to_use: User wants something currently in the post body to live outside the block tree — featured image, excerpt, title/slug, or another non-content destination — often phrased as move/promote/use as / take out of the content.
triggers: remove from the page but keep
principles: Leaving the content is NOT ahentic-browser/move-blocks. move-blocks only reorders/reparents inside the canvas.

Pattern: (1) resolve the source block(s) and needed attrs (e.g. image id/url, text), (2) write the destination with the correct ability, (3) ahentic-browser/delete-blocks on the source unless the user asked to keep both.
Featured / thumbnail / cover while editor open → ahentic-browser/set-featured-image with attachment_id, then delete-blocks on the image block.
Excerpt / title / slug while editor open → ahentic-browser/update-post-document, then delete-blocks if the source was body content the user wants removed.
When the block editor is NOT open for that post, use server twins (ahentic/set-featured-image, ahentic/update-post) instead of browser doc tools.
Do not rewrite the whole document with set-blocks just to remove one block after promoting it.
Drafting from scratch: put the H1 in the post title field and start body headings at level 2 — see playbook post-title-headings (this playbook is for promoting something already in the body).
steps: Read selection or get-blocks to identify the source ref(s) and attributes (image id, text, etc.).
Write the destination (set-featured-image or update-post-document, or server abilities if editor closed).
Unless the user wants to keep the inline copy, call delete-blocks on the source refs.
Do not save-post unless the user explicitly asked to save/publish.
anti_patterns: Using move-blocks to “move” something to featured image or excerpt.
Full set-blocks rewrite solely to drop one promoted block.
ahentic/update-post for title/excerpt/slug while the same post is open in the block editor.
Leaving the source block in the body after the user clearly wanted it only as featured/excerpt.
